title: Chain--collider--fork Decompositions of Transitive Tournament
summary: A transitive tournament is an acyclic orientation of a complete graph. We study decompositions and packings of the transitive tournament \(TT_n\) into connected two-arc motifs. The three motifs considered are chains, colliders, and forks, which are also fundamental local configurations in directed acyclic graphs. We first construct decompositions of \(TT_n\) into mixtures of these motifs whenever such decompositions exist. We then consider the corresponding pure packing problem for each individual motif.
